findings.finding: Management's own H1 report (3 Sep) says the 100% NFZ payment for oncology follow-up CT/MR (Zarządzenie 61/2026, backdated to 1 Apr) helped Q2 and will help later quarters more, and NFZ raised CT/MR contract limits by 2.68% and PET pricing by about 3% from 1 Jul. Both shrink the 50%-paid overperformance share in Q3, the first full quarter they apply.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (diagnostics-driven beat, operating profit +31% vs expectations): shares +11% on 29 May (Parkiet). Q2 2026 beat: +6.8% on 4 Sep (Puls Biznesu headline 'Kurs mocno rośnie'; baseline tape).
findings.original_quote: Zmiana ta miała pozytywny wpływ na poziom przychodów wykazanych w 2Q26 i spodziewamy się większego efektu tych zmian w kolejnych kwartałach. / wprowadzenie przez NFZ od 1 lipca 2026 roku zwiększenia limitów ujętych w umowach – dla badań TK i MR o 2,68% (translation: this change had a positive effect on Q2 revenue and we expect a larger effect in the following quarters / NFZ raised contract limits from 1 July 2026, by 2.68% for CT and MR)
findings.why_not_priced: It has been public for 12 weeks, but the stock has fallen 13.9% in 20 sessions and 10.1% in 5 with no company news, which suggests the market is pricing the NFZ headwind rather than these offsets. If the offsets were priced, the stock would not be trading back near its pre-Q2 level (135 PLN against about 150 in mid-October). Thin coverage ($0.3m/day) means few models carry the July changes. Kept small because it is public and the bar is unsourced.
findings.independence: NFZ's own notice on the final 50%/100% settlement rules: https://www.nfz.gov.pl/aktualnosci/aktualnosci-centrali/zarzadzenie-po-konsultacjach-spolecznych-nfz-uwzglednia-czesc-uwag-i-wprowadza-nowy-sposob-rozliczania-nadwykonan-w-diagnostyce,8916.html

findings.finding: Alteris (IT and infrastructure) had an estimated 2026 backlog of about 185m PLN against 113m realised in H1, which implies about 72m in H2 2026 against about 49m implied for H2 2025 (130m backlog at end-Aug 2025, less 80.7m in H1 2025). That points to y/y Alteris growth in Q3, though well below Q2's 77m quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Alteris drove the Q2 beat (2.5x y/y revenue); the stock rose 6.8% on the day after.
findings.original_quote: szacowany backlog na rok 2026 roku wynosi około 185 milionów złotych, podczas gdy pod koniec sierpnia 2025 roku backlog na 2025 roku wynosił około 130 milionów złotych – w konsekwencji spodziewany wzrost sprzedaży w 2026 roku r/r (translation: the estimated 2026 backlog is about 185m PLN, against about 130m for 2025 at end-August 2025, so sales growth is expected in 2026)
findings.why_not_priced: The H2 split is an inference (backlog minus H1 realised), not something the company stated. The lumpiness cuts both ways: a q/q group revenue fall from 184.8m is the likely headline even if Alteris grows y/y, which is why the range is wide and the size small.

findings.finding: Under the 50% overperformance regime, Q2 showed Voxel-parent key exams -12% y/y and revenue -2% y/y, with diagnostic gross margins down (Voxel -2pp, Scanix -5pp, Rezonans Powiśle -12pp). Q3 2025 was fully paid at 100%, so Q3 2026 diagnostics faces the same y/y headwind for a full quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2, diagnostics weakness was masked by Alteris and the stock rose 6.8%. Parkiet (29 May) said the NFZ change would hit Voxel much harder than Diagnostyka, and the stock had sold off on that fear before Q1.
findings.original_quote: W 2Q26 Spółka odnotowała zmniejszenie przychodów ze sprzedaży o 3% r/r i o 13% kw./kw. ... Niższa liczba badań w 2Q26 wynikała z wprowadzonych zmian w sposobie finansowania przez NFZ badań TK i MR wykonywanych w ramach tzw. nadwykonań (translation: in Q2 the company's key-exam revenue fell 3% y/y and 13% q/q ... lower Q2 exam volumes resulted from NFZ's change in how CT/MR overperformance is funded)
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: it is the market's known worry, and the recent 14% drawdown is consistent with it. Kept small and negative because Q3 is the first quarter where the y/y comparison carries no Q1-style full-pay months.
findings.independence: https://www.parkiet.com/medycyna-i-zdrowie/art44494951-voxel-i-diagnostyka-drozeja-problemow-w-wynikach-jeszcze-nie-widac ('Ze względu na strukturę biznesu znacznie mocniej uderzą w Voxel niż w Diagnostykę')

findings.finding: About 16m PLN of 2025 PET/SPECT overperformance receivables (Voxel and Exira) were neither invoiced nor settled at 3 Sep, and the company expected payment 'within the coming months'. Because the parent books only an estimate until NFZ settles, a Q3 settlement could add a one-off revenue top-up, as the 2.2m one did in Q1 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 2025 settlement of 2.2m PLN passed without a separately identifiable reaction.
findings.original_quote: suma należności z tytułu badań wykonanych w ramach nadwykonań w ubiegłym rok ... które nie zostały zafakturowane i odnośnie których nie otrzymano propozycji aneksów czy ugód wyniosła około 16 milionów złotych ... Grupa oczekuje zapłaty za te świadczenia w ciągu najbliższych miesięcy (translation: receivables for last year's overperformance exams, not invoiced and with no annex or settlement proposed, totalled about 16m PLN ... the Group expects payment within the coming months)
findings.why_not_priced: Whether and when NFZ settled is not public. It is a one-off with no path to the guide (none exists), so it is sized at a fraction of the money.

findings.finding: The issuer brought the Q3 report forward by one day, from 26 to 25 November (RB 24/2026). This confirms the event and its timing; the move carries no directional content.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 report was moved on 25 Aug (to 3 Sep), followed by a beat and +6.8%; that is one observation.

findings.why_not_priced: It is a public timing fact and carries no directional information.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive against a -13.9% 20-day run-up. Because the lean is the run-up itself (+0.695 contrarian), the findings agree with the lean and add little to the free control; the orthogonal part is the issuer's July pricing and limit changes and the Alteris backlog.
language_note: The primary document (H1 management report, Polish only) carried the quantified outlook factors: 100% oncology follow-up pay with a larger effect in later quarters, July limit increases of +2.68% CT/MR, the 185m Alteris backlog, and the 16m unsettled receivables. No English source carried any of them.
The ESPI notice 24/2026 moving the report to 25 Nov (which settles the window) was only found via Polish sources (biznesradar); English calendars still showed 26 Nov.
Parkiet (Polish) gave the Q1 reaction (+11% on 29 May), which corrects the baseline's cadence-estimated history (it placed that print on 2026-06-15 at -2.21%).
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told': findings 1 and 3 rest on the public H1 outlook and were moved toward 0 (+0.5 to +0.3, -0.6 to -0.4); finding 2 is an inference and went from +0.4 to +0.3.

'Size the move on what is new; let reaction history move p_up, not abs_move': abs_move raised from 7.0 to 7.5 (numbers are new, $0.3m/day turnover, last two prints +11% and +6.8%); the unsourced bar pulls p_up from 55 to 54 and print_vs_bar from +3 to +2.

'Session is the most load-bearing field / open session_check with the verdict': written as bmo-equivalent because the release lands after the 25 Nov close; amc on the 26th would point the resolver at the wrong window.
'The move is in the guide': Voxel gives no guidance, so no guidance finding is possible; noted in new_in_release.
